column1: # Native-command music replacements. Format: slot filename [loop|once]
# OGG paths are relative to Sdata/MUSIC. There is no level timer or native-mix ducking.
# These numbered defaults match the N64 recordings; see docs/EXTERNAL_MUSIC.md.
# Track02 is the theme/crawl, NOT the menu. main_menu.ogg is a verified cue reconstruction.
# Its Vorbis LOOPSTART/LOOPEND comments retain an intro followed by a continuous loop.
# A missing/unreadable menu file still falls back to original native 0x62.
# Short-cue slots, continuing after Track14. Both play once.
# Stereo reconstructions verified against the supplied native/PC references:
# MP3-sourced fan edits, not certified lossless masters; see the verification report.
# Missing/corrupt files retain the native cue rather than silently dropping it.
# Track05 and Track09 are intentionally unassigned: no verified native match.
